caption: The drawing features two similar objects, both predominantly brown in color, set against an off-white background. Each object has a rounded, pouch-like shape with a slightly flared opening. The upper object displays three curved parallel ridges on its front side and concentric circular patterns at the top. The lower object shows more ornate detailing, with carved circular and curved patterns along the front, and an additional round, silver-toned disk featuring an etched starburst design at the top center. Both objects have smooth, shaded surfaces suggesting a leather-like material and are positioned separately, one above the other, with the bottom right corner containing the text "Arthur E. Reynolds."
title: Stirrups
